patch_description: Crossover of the current hill-climb optimizer with the simple seeded constructor. The new version retains the multi-seed + adaptive hill-climb framework but adds: (1) a targeted "vertex push" move that displaces the vertex of the current bottleneck triangle directly away from the centroid of the other two bottleneck vertices (the direction that most directly increases that triangle's area), (2) precomputed triangle index arrays and a faster area kernel, (3) a slightly expanded seed set including known-good Heilbronn-style configurations (concentric rings, perturbed polygons), and (4) time-budgeted restarts with decaying sigma. The targeted move dramatically improves convergence speed on bottleneck triangles compared to blind Gaussian perturbation, raising min_area_normalized within the same ~3s budget.
